chunks: Verily God has enjoined justice, the doing of good, and the giving of gifts to your relatives; and forbidden indecency, impropriety and oppression. He warns you so that you may remember.
ai.seo_question: What are the key moral commands and prohibitions in Surah An-Nahl verse 90?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Verse of Comprehensive Ethics' (Ayat al-Takmilah), this verse is central to Shia jurisprudence, where scholars like Al-Sharif al-Murtada and Al-Tusi interpret 'giving to kin' (I'ta' Dhi al-Qurba) as a distinct obligation often linked to the right of the Ahl al-Bayt. It establishes a holistic framework where moral excellence (Ihsan) complements legal justice (Adl), serving as a foundational text for both individual piety and social equity in Twelver Shi'ism.
